name: list_projects
description: Get all Planka projects with board counts. Use to discover available projects and their IDs.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return (default: 50)

name: list_board_summary
description: Get a board overview with lists and card counts. Use to understand board structure and find specific lists/cards.

name: find_cards
description: Search for cards on a board by name or list. Returns compact card summaries (id, name, list). Use to locate specific tasks.

limit.description: Maximum number of cards to return (default: 50)

list_id.description: Optional list ID to filter cards by list

query.description: Optional search term to filter cards by name (case-insensitive)

name: get_card_context
description: FIRST CALL when the user gives you a Planka card URL. Extract the id from `/cards/{id}` and pass it as `card_id`. Returns the card plus its project, board, sibling lists (with names and ids), board labels, board members, plus the card's own labels/members/tasks — enough to comment, move, update, or assign without any further discovery. Card description is sanitized (images stripped, capped at 1500 chars).

card_id.description: The card ID (extract from a Planka URL like https://.../cards/{card_id})

name: get_card
description: Get a single card by id (name, sanitized description, list_id, tasks). Does NOT return sibling lists or board context — use `get_card_context` when you also need to know what columns exist on the board.

name: create_card
description: Create a new task card in a list. Returns the created card ID.

card_type.description: Card type (e.g. 'task', 'project', 'story'). Defaults to PLANKA_DEFAULT_CARD_TYPE env var or 'task'.

list_id.description: The list ID to create the card in

name: update_card
description: Update a card's title or description. Works with only `card_id` + the field(s) to change. Do NOT pre-fetch the card unless you need to read the existing description to merge edits.

name: move_card
description: Move a card to a different list. Pass `list_name` (e.g. "Done") when you only know the column by name — the server resolves it on the card's own board. Pass `list_id` if you already have it. Exactly one of the two is required. Do NOT pre-fetch the board just to translate a name.

list_id.description: The target list ID. Provide this OR `list_name`, not both.

list_name.description: Target list name (case-insensitive) on the card's own board. Provide this OR `list_id`, not both.

name: add_comment
description: Post a comment on a card. Works with only `card_id` + `text` — do NOT call `get_card` or `get_card_context` first unless you also need other context. Commenting does not require knowing the board.

card_id.description: The card ID to comment on

name: delete_card
description: Delete a card permanently (destructive operation - not recommended).
